scripts.emulators: npm run build:functions && NODE_OPTIONS="--require $PWD/scripts/emulator-loopback-direct.cjs" firebase emulators:start --project demo-partey --only auth,firestore,database,functions
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && npm --prefix functions exec -- tsc -p functions/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --project prod --only firestore,database,functions,hosting
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build && firebase deploy --project prod --only hosting
scripts.test:e2e: node tests/e2e/flow.mjs && node tests/e2e/gameplay.mjs && node tests/e2e/impostor.mjs && node tests/e2e/impostor-custom-word.mjs
